## Install

Follow the installation instructions at https://nodejs.org/en/download, then run:

```bash
npm install --save-dev table-formatter
```

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Option  | Default | Description                     |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------- |
| `width` | `80`    | Maximum table width in columns. |
